label: Weak, cause-of-being version of cause has what it gives: whatever causes a…, from preexistence
description: From ST I q.4 a.2 (the perfections of a thing whose being a cause causes are in that cause) and the OPEN premise that a caused perfection is had by its effect, a cause of a thing's being has every perfection it causes in that thing. Only this weak, cause-of-being version follows: the map's edge to the unrestricted STMT-CAUSE-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES would need every cause of a perfection to be a cause of being, which the heater refutes.
